themoviechannel.us.title: American Assassin
themoviechannel.us.description: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Organ Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. (Western, Horror, Thriller) - 2023

themoviechannel.us.title: Election
themoviechannel.us.description: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. (Comedy drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Old Guy
themoviechannel.us.description: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. (Action, Comedy) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
themoviechannel.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Area 51
themoviechannel.us.description: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada. (Science fiction, Horror, Mystery) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: The Relic
themoviechannel.us.description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home. (Horror) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Ring
themoviechannel.us.description: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: The Ring Two
themoviechannel.us.description: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy
themoviechannel.us.description: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) has come to earth to strengthen his powers by claiming the wicked spirit of a psychotic veteran. The benevolent angel, Simon (Eric Stoltz), want to stop that from happening, so hides the man's spirit where Gabriel would least expect to find it: in a little girl (Moriah Shining Dove Snyder). Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child. (Fantasy, Thriller) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy II
themoviechannel.us.description: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) rises from hell to declare war on God and humanity. To win the spiritual war, Gabriel has to kill Los Angeles nurse Valerie Rosales (Jennifer Beals) -- and, more importantly, her unborn half-angel baby. Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches. (Horror) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy 3: The Ascent
themoviechannel.us.description: Danyael is the offspring of an angel and a mortal woman. After being gunned down in a seemingly fatal shooting, he rises from the dead and realizes he possesses great powers. The evil angels Pyriel and Zophael then set out to convince Danyael to do their bidding and help wreak havoc on the planet. But former angel Gabriel, who was cast down to earth in human form, tries to sway Danyael toward the path of righteousness. (Horror) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy IV: Uprising
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman (Kari Wuhrer) must protect an ancient religious manuscript from renegade angels. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy: Forsaken
themoviechannel.us.description: A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Sea Hawk
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Framed for murder by his own half-brother, Sir Oliver Tressilian is impressed into service aboard a British ship. When that ship is captured by the Spanish Armada, he is put to work as a galley slave. Escaping to a band of Barbary pirates, he eventually becomes their leader. He gains wealth and fame during his adventures as "The Sea Hawk," but he dreams of returning to England to exact revenge on his brother -- and to reclaim his fiancée. (Adventure) - 1924

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Beloved Rogue
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: French 15th-century poet François Villon (John Barrymore) loses his father at a young age, a martyr to the French cause. Villon follows in his father's footsteps, fighting ardently for his country while becoming a poet and jester. Appointed king for the day, he goes too far when he makes a joke at the expense of the Duke of Burgundy (Lawson Butt) and is exiled by King Louis XI (Conrad Veidt). He has to prove to the king that it's the duke who is the real enemy of France. (Adventure, Historical drama) - 1927

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Scaramouche
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An 18th-century Frenchman poses as a clown and meets a master swordsman in a duel of revenge. (Adventure) - 1923

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this silent film adaptation of Anthony Hope's classic novel, Rudolf Rassendyll (Lewis Stone) visits the small European country of Ruritania to see his distant cousin's coronation as king. Rassendyll bears an unusual resemblance to the king, so when the ruler is poisoned and kidnapped, Rassendyll is forced to pose as the new monarch. As he works with the ruler's men to discover who is behind the kidnapping, Rassendyll slowly falls in love with the king's fiancée, Princess Flavia (Alice Terry). (Romance) - 1922

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bathing Beauty
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Songwriter Steve Elliot (Red Skelton) has just wed his sweetheart, Caroline Brooks (Esther Williams), when a scheming Broadway producer breaks up the marriage. Caroline returns to her position as a college swimming instructor at a girls' college. Desperate to set things right, Elliot enrolls at the college as its sole male student and tries to get Caroline to fall in love with him all over again. But he'll face some competition from stodgy botany professor Willis Evans (Bill Goodwin). (Musical, Comedy) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Harvey Girls
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Susan Bradley (Judy Garland) responded to an ad in New Mexico for a mail-order bride, she had no idea that her would-be husband was a broken-down cowhand. Instead of returning home, she takes a job at the local Harvey House restaurant. But the new establishment faces tough resistance from the local saloon owner (John Hodiak) and the town's streetwise showgirl, Em (Angela Lansbury). As Susan works with the Harvey girls to win over the townsfolk, she also searches for a new love. (Musical comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cass Timberlane
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A judge in a small Minnesota town, Cass Timberlane (Spencer Tracy) is cultured and enjoys a sterling reputation. When he falls for working-class girl Jinny Marshland (Lana Turner) and they get married, his life begins to unravel. Jinny grows restless and starts having an affair with Cass' friend Bradd Criley (Zachary Scott), a younger lawyer, leaving the judge heartbroken and betrayed. So when she attempts to return to Cass, their relationship might be irreparably damaged. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Key to the City
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Steve Fisk (Clark Gable) is a longshoreman turned mayor of a small California city. Clarissa Standish (Loretta Young) is an upper-class, college-educated woman and mayor of a little town in Maine. While attending a mayors' convention in San Francisco, the two opposites meet and eventually fall in love. But romantic misunderstandings during the convention, and political dealings with Fisk's rival, crooked politician Les Taggart (Raymond Burr), threaten to put a stop to their romance. (Comedy) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Show Boat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When it comes to music on the Mississippi River, the Cotton Blossom show boat is the place to go. When musical main attraction Julie Laverne and her husband are suddenly forced to leave the show, Cotton Blossom owner Andy Hawks' own daughter, Magnolia, takes center stage. She soon falls madly in love with roguish gambler Gaylord Ravenal, and the two leave the Cotton Blossom on a honeymoon -- only to enter into a tumultuous marriage. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Young Bess
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Anne Boleyn (Elaine Stewart) is executed for infidelity, her daughter Elizabeth (Jean Simmons) is sent into exile by King Henry VIII (Charles Laughton). Elizabeth grows into a spirited young woman. Eventually, she is summoned back to London to meet Henry's latest bride, Catherine Parr (Deborah Kerr). She also meets Admiral Thomas Seymour (Stewart Granger) and becomes instantly enamored. Unfortunately for her, the machinations of politics prove far more potent than love. (Historical drama) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Day the Earth Caught Fire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Peter Stenning (Edward Judd) is a depressed British reporter who gets by with the help of his friend, veteran journalist Bill Maguire (Leo McKern). Along with weather forecaster Jeannie Craig (Janet Munro), Peter and Bill discover that simultaneous U.S. and Russian nuclear explosions have drastically altered the earth's rotation. Fires and earthquakes ravage cities all over the world, and chaos and sickness descend upon the frightened survivors as they try to put the planet back on its axis. (Science fiction) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Silent Running
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the end of all botanical life on Earth, ecologist Freeman Lowell (Bruce Dern) maintains a greenhouse on a space station in order to preserve various plants for future generations. Assisted by three robots and a small human crew, Lowell rebels when he is ordered to destroy the greenhouse in favor of carrying cargo, a decision that puts him at odds with everyone but his mechanical companions. Lowell and his robots are forced to do anything necessary to keep their invaluable greenery alive. (Science fiction) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: No Blade of Grass
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Londoner (Nigel Davenport) leads his wife (Jean Wallace) and family through anarchy after a virus wipes out the world's crops. (Science fiction) - 1970

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Them!
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While investigating a series of mysterious deaths, Sergeant Ben Peterson (James Whitmore) finds a young girl (Sandy Descher) who is unable to speak. As Peterson joins forces with FBI agent Robert Graham (James Arness) and scientist Dr. Harold Medford (Edmund Gwenn), he discovers that all the incidents are due to giant ants that have been mutated by atomic radiation. Peterson and Graham, with the aid of the military, attempt to find the queen ants and destroy the nests before the danger spreads. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1954

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Tangible Affection Proof. While the guys try to give their significant others the perfect Valentine's Day, Raj and Stuart throw a lonely people party at the comic book store. S6, Ep16

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: The Monster Isolation. After a terrible date, Raj vows to never leave his apartment again. Meanwhile, Penny actually impresses Sheldon with her acting skills. S6, Ep17

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory
tlc.uk.description: Contractual Obligation Implementation. Leonard, Sheldon and Howard try to advance the cause of women in science by speaking with junior high girls about their future careers. S6, Ep18

tlc.uk.title: The Big Bang Theory

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E2 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 2 A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock and a ship is wrecked. The survivors take shelter in the lighthouse but all are in deadly peril from the alien menace that stalks the island.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E3 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 3 The Doctor seals the survivors inside the lighthouse but discovers that he may unwittingly have trapped the creature inside with them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E4 Horror of Fang Rock: Part 4 As the alien Rutan picks off the remaining humans one by one, the Doctor devises a desperate plan to defeat the alien and repel the approaching Rutan mothership.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S14 E16 The Face of Evil: Part 4 The insane computer Xoanon refuses the Doctor's help and prepares to destroy the planet.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E5 The Invisible Enemy: Part 1 An alien virus infects the human crew of a refuelling station on Titan, one of the moons of Saturn. The Doctor is also infected and becomes possessed by the will of the Nucleus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E7 The Invisible Enemy: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela have been cloned and miniaturised and injected into the Doctor's body. There they must fight the virus on a microscopic level before time runs out.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E8 The Invisible Enemy: Part 4 The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size. Its plans to spawn and infect the whole galaxy are nearing fruition. And it looks like K-9 has a new master….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E9 Image of the Fendahl: Part 1 The Doctor and Leela arrive in present day England at Fetch Priory where a mysterious skull that is older than mankind is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E10 Image of the Fendahl: Part 2 As Thea succumbs to the power of the skull, the Doctor realises that an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people is manifesting at Fetch Priory.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E11 Image of the Fendahl: Part 3 Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself. The Doctor and Leela take a trip in the TARDIS to discover the truth about the ancient evil from the dawn of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E12 Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E13 The Sun Makers: Part 1 The TARDIS arrives on Pluto which has been made habitable and turned into a giant factory where the ruthless Company exploits its under-paid workers.

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E14 The Sun Makers: Part 2 The Doctor is taken prisoner by the Gatherer and sent to the Correction Centre. Leela mounts a rescue attempt, but the Gatherer’s men are waiting.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E16 The Sun Makers: Part 4 The Others launch a full-scale uprising against the Gatherer and his Inner Retinue while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E1 Asa Butterfield, Micky Flanagan and Anjli Mohindra Stephen Mangan and Joan Bakewell co-present Portrait Artist of the Year from The Grand Hall of Battersea Arts Centre in London, which is transformed into an art studio in a quest to find the best creative talent.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Adventures In Americana
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Florida George is in Florida, exploring everything from outer space at NASA, to Hurricane-safe homes, visiting the famous Art Deco Quarter and Little Havana in Miami.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E48 Episode 48 Richard Osman hosts as lexicographer Susie Dent, newsreader Nick Owen, alpine ski racer Chemmy Alcott and comedian Dane Baptiste test their general knowledge skills.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E3 Jemma Rix, Nazeem Hussain, Tom Cardy & Danielle Walker Adam, Myf and Alan are joined by Tom Cardy, Jemma Rix, Nazeem Hussain and Danielle Walker in a show featuring throat singing, a Zuckerberg singing, a magician's bird getting quite disappointed and Brian Mannix in a bathtub.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E12 Medieval And Macabre Stephen Fry returns for his final season as host of the quiz show with a difference. Panellists include Julia Zemiro, Matt Lucas and David Mitchell along with Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E9 The Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode of previously unseen material from the comedy panel show. Over the course of the show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves. But are they true?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Return To Paradise
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Checking Out When Colin's friends visit from England, one of them wakes up to find a stranger's corpse in his locked motel room, with no sign of how the killer got out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E18 Dead Man's Tale Sherlock and Joan question how well they know Shinwell when they investigate the unsolved murder of his friend, a fellow gang member. Also, Sherlock and Joan's latest case puts them on the hunt for a treasure map.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Full Moon, Saturday Night The moon is full and so is the ER. Hathaway's patient believes that he is a werewolf. Dr. Greene is still haunted by the death of Jodi O'Brien and isn't sure he can function as a doctor. Benton tends to his sick mother.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E2 Skiing During a skiing trip in Eastern Europe, Lee, Lucy and Daisy get stuck in a cable car with a heavily pregnant woman who speaks little English but definitely doesn't want to hang around.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Vault: Director Jim Yukich ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E273 rage Vault: Director Pedro Romhanyi From Pulp to Kylie Minogue, The Sugarcubes, Manic Street Preachers and more, rage digs into the VAULT to bring you the best music videos directed by Pedro Romhanyi.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Bank Job
ABCMESydney.au.description: A car dealer with a dodgy past, Terry, has always avoided major-league scams. But when Martine, a model, offers him a lead on a fool proof bank hit on London's Baker Street, Terry recognises the opportunity of a lifetime.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E9 Episode 9 Aisha Tyler hosts another laughter-filled episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie, along with guest performer Charles Esten.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E1 Asa Butterfield, Micky Flanagan and Anjli Mohindra Stephen Mangan and Joan Bakewell co-present Portrait Artist of the Year from The Grand Hall of Battersea Arts Centre in London, which is transformed into an art studio in a quest to find the best creative talent.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Incomprehensible In keeping with the theme this episode of QI is utterly 'Incomprehensible'. QI master Stephen Fry is joined by Alan Davies, Prof Brian Cox, Ross Noble and Sue Perkins.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E39 The Blossom Files Blossom's skepticism is put to the test when she believes she's encountered a space alien.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E45 The Legend of Pumpkin Guts Mavis is determined to break out of lockdown once and for all to learn just why all monster kids are locked away on Halloween. But once she does find out, she kind of wishes she'd listened and stayed inside.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E14 Buttercup vs. Math When Buttercup tests into Honors Math, she tries to avoid being labeled a nerd.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir

fxm.us.title: The Unholy
fxm.us.description: A girl inexplicably gains the power to heal the sick after a supposed visitation from the Virgin Mary. As word spreads and people flock to witness her miracles, a disgraced journalist visits the small New England town to investigate. However, when strange events start to occur, he soon wonders if these phenomena are the result of something more sinister. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: The Three Musketeers
fxm.us.description: In this musical comedy version of Alexandre Dumas' timeless novel, D'Artagnan (Don Ameche), a French peasant with dreams of joining the Musketeers, sets out for Paris. On the road, he comes across the three warriors. Athos (Douglas Dumbrille) challenges D'Artagnan to a duel, but eventually all four become fast friends. The Musketeers make an ally of the Queen of France (Gloria Stuart) and find themselves constantly dueling with the wicked Milady De Winter (Binnie Barnes). (Musical comedy) - 1939

fxm.us.title: Champagne Charlie
fxm.us.description: A young heiress (Helen Wood) becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a smooth gambler (Paul Cavanagh). (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1936

fxm.us.title: Hombre
fxm.us.description: John Russell finds that the world is not so welcoming when he returns to his Arizona hometown to collect his inheritance. A white man raised by American Indians, Russell is subjected to numerous instances of racism when people discover his background. When the stagecoach Russell is riding in is held up by a gang run by one of the scheming passengers, Cicero Grimes, it falls to Russell to defend the passengers -- the very people who have dismissed and insulted him. (Western) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Bandolero!
fxm.us.description: There is little hope for bandit Dee Bishop (Dean Martin) and his gang as they wait to be hanged. But at the last second, the hangman -- Dee's brother, Mace (James Stewart), in disguise -- helps them escape. After kidnapping a rancher's wife (Raquel Welch) and with the vengeful sheriff (George Kennedy) in pursuit, they retreat to an abandoned town. Tired of their desperado life, the brothers consider going straight. But when a gang of bandoleros attacks, their chances at starting over seem dim. (Western, Drama) - 1968

fxm.us.title: 100 Rifles
fxm.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

fxm.us.title: Lincoln
fxm.us.description: With the nation embroiled in still another year with the high death count of Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln brings the full measure of his passion, humanity and political skill to what would become his defining legacy: to end the war and permanently abolish slavery through the 13th Amendment. Having great courage, acumen and moral fortitude, Lincoln pushes forward to compel the nation, and those in government who oppose him, to aim toward a greater good for all mankind. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Tolkien
fxm.us.description: As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2019

5starmax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
5starmax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Road House
5starmax.us.description: The Double Deuce is the meanest, loudest and rowdiest bar south of the Mason-Dixon Line, and Dalton (Patrick Swayze) has been hired to clean it up. He might not look like much, but the Ph.D.-educated bouncer proves he's more than capable -- busting the heads of troublemakers and turning the roadhouse into a jumping hot-spot. But Dalton's romance with the gorgeous Dr. Clay (Kelly Lynch) puts him on the bad side of cutthroat local big shot Brad Wesley (Ben Gazzara). (Action, Thriller) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Science fiction) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante
5starmax.us.description: A monster dinosaur wrecks Tokyo some more and meets a monster plant created from his own cells. (Science fiction) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Red Riding Hood
5starmax.us.description: Young Valerie (Amanda Seyfried) feels torn between two men. She loves Peter, but her parents intend that she marry wealthy Henry. Valerie and Peter are going to run away together, but her sister is killed by a werewolf before they can put their plan into action. The villagers call on the help of Father Solomon (Gary Oldman), a famous monster hunter who warns that the beast takes human form by day. Then Valerie suspects that the werewolf is someone she loves. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Romance) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
5starmax.us.description: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2008

5starmax.us.title: The Last Samurai
5starmax.us.description: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. (Adventure, Drama, War, Action) - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Cocktail
5starmax.us.description: Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue). (Romance, Comedy drama) - 1988

5starmax.us.title: Carrie
5starmax.us.description: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror) - 1976

5starmax.us.title: Final Destination 5
5starmax.us.description: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: Fantastic Planet
5starmax.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

cartoonnetwork.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
cartoonnetwork.us.description: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Renunciation

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Heaven
bbcamerica.us.description: A catastrophic fire at a dance club leads to the prosecution of an immigrations officer who supplied bogus papers to aliens. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1991-11-26

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Africa - Savannah
bbcamerica.us.description: In the constantly changing climate of East Africa, creatures must be able to deal with unpredictable elements. (Documentary, Nature) - 2013-01-09

bbcamerica.us.title: The Wild Sides - Growing Up
bbcamerica.us.description: Mashatu is now a thriving Eden; parents focus on teaching and feeding bountiful young. (Documentary, Nature) - 2023-08-19

bbcamerica.us.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet - Asia
bbcamerica.us.description: Asia is the largest and most extreme continent on the planet, stretching from the Arctic Circle to the tropical forests on the Equator. (Nature, Documentary) - 2019-11-03

bbcamerica.us.title: American Gangster
bbcamerica.us.description: Frank Lucas earns his living as a chauffeur to one of Harlem's leading mobsters. After his boss dies, Frank uses his own ingenuity and strict business code to become one of the inner city's most powerful crime bosses. Veteran cop Richie Roberts senses a change in the mob's power structure and looks for ways to bring his opponent to justice. (Crime drama, Biography) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Point Break
bbcamerica.us.description: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1991

bbcamerica.us.title: The Patriot
bbcamerica.us.description: Mel Gibson portrays Benjamin Martin, an unassuming man who is forced to join the American Revolution when the British threaten to take his farm away from him. Together with his patriotic son, Gabriel, the pair faces the vicious Redcoats with a heroism that reflects the stubborn pride of a young country's most dedicated supporters. (War, Historical drama, Action) - 2000

bbcamerica.us.title: Tombstone
bbcamerica.us.description: Wyatt Earp and his brothers, Morgan and Virgil, have left their gunslinger ways behind them to settle down and start a business in the town of Tombstone, Ariz. While they aren't looking to find trouble, trouble soon finds them when they become targets of the ruthless Cowboy gang. Now, together with Wyatt's best friend, Doc Holliday, the brothers pick up their guns once more to restore order to a lawless land. (Western, Action) - 1993

bbcamerica.us.title: A Few Good Men
bbcamerica.us.description: Lt. Daniel Kaffee (Tom Cruise) is a military lawyer defending two U.S. Marines charged with killing a fellow Marine at the Guantánamo Bay Naval Base in Cuba. Although Kaffee is known for seeking plea bargains, a fellow lawyer, Lt. Cdr. JoAnne Galloway (Demi Moore), convinces him that the accused marines were most likely carrying out an order from a commanding officer. Kaffee takes a risk by calling Col. Nathan R. Jessep (Jack Nicholson) to the stand in an effort to uncover the conspiracy. (Drama) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Out of the Light

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Big Sea

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Supply & Demand

bouncetv.us.title: The Protégé

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Mexican Carne Asada Hero
tastemade.us.description: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
tastemade.us.description: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Seafood Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Essence of Grill Culture
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes. (Cooking)

fifthgear.us.description: S11 E08 Tom Ford and Jonny Smith enter a demolition derby in two unlikely vehicles, Reliant Robins; Tiff Needell tests the latest Porsche 911, the GT3RS; Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the new Vauxhall VXR8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i; it's an impressive machine, costing £50,000, it does 150mph; Jason Plato tests the ultimate track car, the brand-new Lotus 2 Eleven.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E10 Tom spends the day with the scourge of modern day motorists: wheel clampers; Vicki tests the Nissan 350Z.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E01 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out what's quick in the shoot-out feature, the brand-new Audi S5 or the BMW 335i; England rugby star Kyran Bracken is given some circuit driving tuition from Jason Plato.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the new 207 GTI is as exhilarating to drive as the 20-year-old hot hatch, the 205 GTI; Fifth Gear conducts a fascinating world's first crash test - we crash a 15-year-old Volvo 940.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E03 Diesel Mini vs a gas one; comparing the new Subaru Impreza to a previous version.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E04 Checking police driving skills on a racetrack; testing small economy cars on one of Britain's biggest hills.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E05 Comparing Audi TT's semi-automatic gearbox vs a manual one.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E06 The BMW Z4 and Nissan 350Z go head-to-head on the track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E07 Naming which TV cop car is fastest; celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Deuce Coupe; testing the Gumpert Apollo; building a drift car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E08 Tiff Needell gets behind the wheel of the cutting-edge Ferrari 430 Scuderia.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E09 A Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera; a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E10 Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from precision driver Russ Swift; Jonny Smith secretly repairs potholes; Tom Ford drives a Monster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E06 Jason is joined by ex-Ferrari F1 driver Mika Salon to pit the brand new £100,000 Mercedes C63 AMG Black Series against its key rival from BMW. Tiff celebrates the iconic Ferrari F40's 25th birthday with a track drive of one of the best in the world.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E07 Jonny Smith goes behind the scenes at the grueling Isle of Man TT motorbike race, and spends the day with TT hero and 19 times winner John McGuinness. Tiff Needell races around the infamous TT circuit in the brand new Subaru BRZ sports car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E08 Ferrari Aluminum Denmark motorbike speedway; Ferrari supercar; examining fuel-saving technologies that boast economical advantages.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: The big names of the automotive world go under the hood to discuss reviews, news and bargains of the industry.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki holds a spectacular race against a jet plane in the ultimate test of the brand-new Porsche Boxster. Jonny heads to Norway to test the all new Ford Focus ST hot hatch on an incredible road that every driver should visit in their lifetime.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E11 Jason's in Italy to drive the most talked about hypercar of the year - the 730bhp Pagani Huayra. He's given an exclusive tour of how this incredible machine is made at the company's HQ, and lets the car off the leash on road and track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson and Jonny Smith pit two brand-new four-door supercars head-to-head at the track - Mercedes CLS63 AMG versus Porsche Panamera GTS. Jason heads to the Netherlands to drive what could be the maddest supercar of the year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tiff Needell is joined by rally star Kris Meeke for a hot hatch showdown. With four brand-new models lined up at the track, they hold a high-octane knockout tournament to find which is fastest of all.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jonny enters the world of professional drifting as competes in the famous Gatebil show in Norway, driving a specially modified BMW M5. To give himself a fighting chance, he first arranges some tuition from the 2011 British Drift Champion Matt Carter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E15 Vicki Butler-Henderson is joined by Norwegian rally prodigy Andreas Mikkelsen for a high octane motoring triathlon - race in a 200bhp off-road buggy, perform an autotest in a Škoda Fabia hot hatch, and battle wheel to wheel in single seat race cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E01 Vicki tests two cars, the Lotus Exige S vs. Caterham CSR; Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Land Cruiser; Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black; Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of power sliding.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Someone Was Out There
dateline.us.description: Over the course of a year, violent crimes are committed against two women from the same church; evidence is revealed that suggests the two cases are not just coincidences.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Night Brianna Vanished
dateline.us.description: A teenager disappears from her friend's house before being found dead.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Justice for Bonnie
dateline.us.description: A woman seeks justice for her 18-year-old daughter, who was raped and murdered in an Anchorage state park in 1994.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The House on Shalimar Way
dateline.us.description: When Leslie Neulander dies after what appears to be an accidental fall in the shower in her New York home, two friends join forces to seek justice on her behalf; insiders speak out on the latest twists and the final chapter in the case.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Family Business
dateline.us.description: Money and greed tear two close-knit California families apart.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Window
dateline.us.description: A Florida father is determined to find out what happened to his daughter after her fatal fall from a penthouse apartment in Belgium.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Lauren's Promise
dateline.us.description: When a University of Utah athlete is found murdered on campus, investigators learn that she had reached out to the campus police for help multiple times before her death.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Before the Storm
dateline.us.description: A mother of two who vanishes during a storm turns out to be a victim of something sinister.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - After Midnight
dateline.us.description: Campus cops make a terrible discovery in a dorm room after a boyfriend's weekend visit goes horribly wrong.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Evil Intent
dateline.us.description: When a young woman fails to show up to work and her mother rushes to her home to try to find her, what she discovers begins an investigation that leads to a suspect no one imagined.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Behind the Closet Door
dateline.us.description: After a mother is found murdered in her Virginia home, her son embarks on a 20-year quest for justice that leads him down a dark and twisted path.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - 10 Minutes to Sunset
dateline.us.description: When a pediatric dentist is found dead, police uncover a complex plot and their suspect leads investigators on an international manhunt; the lead detective speaks out for the first time.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Evil Paid a Visit
dateline.us.description: Eleven years after Connecticut mother Donna Palomba is raped in her home, investigators finally track down her attacker; Donna speaks out about the latest developments in the case, including her fight to keep her assailant from walking free.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Frantic
dateline.us.description: When a 23-year-old woman goes missing from a shopping mall in Plano, Texas, her family searches for her, and the police seek out who is responsible for her disappearance.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Girl With the Red Shoes
dateline.us.description: A hairdresser-turned-detective uncovers the truth behind the murder of a teenage girl at a scenic spot on a Utah river.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Friends Until Death
dateline.us.description: The investigation into the death of a college student leads authorities to her theater group and a new crime that exposes the truth.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Tangled
dateline.us.description: After a sudden marriage creates tension between two families, a murder exposes secrets, lies and a long-buried mystery.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deception
dateline.us.description: A woman's disappearance tears her young children apart; a sting operation catches an unlikely villain.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Comic Book Murder
dateline.us.description: Years after a woman is murdered in the back of her comic book store, new evidence is discovered that sends the investigation in a surprising direction.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Secret
dateline.us.description: Investigators search for a New Mexico mechanic who has been missing for eight years.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Knock at the Door
dateline.us.description: A woman continues searching for answers after the investigation into her daughter's murder goes cold.

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Direct Contact
filmriseaction.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Beyond the Lights
shadesofblack.us.description: Though she's been groomed for stardom all her life by an overbearing mother (Minnie Driver), singer Noni (Gugu Mbatha-Raw) is having trouble dealing with her success. Feeling unable to cope any longer, Noni tries to kill herself, but luckily Kaz (Nate Parker), the police officer assigned to be her bodyguard, thwarts her suicide attempt. Noni and Kaz feel an instant attraction, but those in their orbit oppose the romance for fear the pair will stray from the course planned out for both of them. (Drama, Romance) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: The Son of No One
shadesofblack.us.description: When he was a youth in the Queensborough projects, Jonathan White (Channing Tatum) -- then known as Milk -- killed a couple of junkies. His dead father's former partner, Detective Stanford (Al Pacino), got him off the hook for the crime. Now a rookie police officer himself, Jonathan remains haunted by the incident. When a Queens reporter (Juliette Binoche) receives anonymous tips regarding the long-ago crime, the implications for both White and Stanford are clear. (Crime drama) - 2011

shadesofblack.us.title: The Rhythm
shadesofblack.us.description: Robert transforms a group of roller skaters into a championship-caliber ice-hockey team by harnessing their natural talent and passion, but they must confront racism and discrimination in the predominantly white world of the sport. (Drama) - 2024

shadesofblack.us.title: Brotherly Love
shadesofblack.us.description: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves. (Drama) - 2015

shadesofblack.us.title: Precious
shadesofblack.us.description: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination. (Drama) - 2009

shadesofblack.us.title: American Violet
shadesofblack.us.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Fled
shadesofblack.us.description: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: A New Kind of Woman
shadesofblack.us.description: Interpersonal relationships are quickly pushed to the edge as a pompous husband, Brian, and his battered wife, Latavia, hold a brunch with unexpected consequences. When their invited guests, Todd and Glenda arrive, inhibitions are lowered, and lingering hostile and dark secrets are revealed. Sex, relationships, class, and revenge are explored over a bit too much wine. (Drama) - 2021

shadesofblack.us.title: To Live and Die and Live

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market

babytv.ca.description: S01 E09 Snowy Bath Ducky, Ellie and Froggy have fun while it snows in the bath as they play ball, slide and ski around, meet a big snowman, and say hello to a cute, friendly penguin.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Horse The friends have fun sweeping with a broom that turns into a happy horse that giddy ups among lovely mountains and trees, and crosses over a river and cool waterfall, before reuniting with his amazing family.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Train Ride The friends have fun playing with colourful chairs that turn into train seats. The train gets stuck on a mountain and the animals help push it along to bring them safely back home.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Blanket The friends have an amazing time covering themselves up with a blanket!

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S01 E10 Toy Egg Tickles is in a mischievous mood and brings a toy egg with a popping-out chicken to a picnic.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S01 E11 Blanket The friends are playing games together when they decide to wash Dodo's blanket because it is smelly, but it blows away in the wind when they leave it out to dry in the sun.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S01 E12 Fruit Party Everyone is making fun fruit costumes for the fruit party, and Yum Yum's friends are on their way.

babytv.ca.title: Tiny Bunch
babytv.ca.description: Everyone Was Busy That Day Baby wants to play with his friends, but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof and Hippo is painting his boat.

babytv.ca.title: Tiny Bunch
babytv.ca.description: Carrot Cake Elephant and Baby have come over to Rabbit's house to have some of his delicious carrot cake. Join them as they switch forks, chairs and cake until everyone finds just the right size.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Signs Billy and Bam-Bam have fun making a pile of colourful stones in the garden.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Colors Billy and Bam-Bam have a wonderful time taking turns swinging on the swing outside.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Mini Golf Billy and Bam-Bam enjoy playing with building blocks in their room on a rainy morning.

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.ca.description: Mail Carrier Join Mona and Sketch as they set out on an adventure to become mail carriers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a mail bag and packages! What's missing? A mail carrier's outfit, of course! Turtle wants to receive mail!

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.ca.description: Pilot Join Mona and Sketch as they set out on an adventure to become pilots! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles an aeroplane and flight goggles! What's missing? A pilot's uniform, of course! Come fly high in the sky!

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail
babytv.ca.description: Dormice Mr Snail meets a sleepy dormouse who sleeps throughout the entire winter and promises to take pictures of winter puddles, snow and rain for the dormouse to enjoy when he wakes up.

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail
babytv.ca.description: Chameleon Mr Snail meets a magical chameleon, who is first green and then changes to brown. Mr Snail discovers that chameleons are amazing animals as they adapt their colours to their surroundings.

babytv.ca.title: Ahoy Pirates

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail

babytv.ca.title: LaLe Ki LoLu

skydrama.uk.title: All Is True (2018)
skydrama.uk.description: The year is 1613, and Shakespeare is acknowledged as the greatest writer of the age. But disaster strikes when his renowned Globe Theatre burns to the ground. Devastated, Shakespeare returns to Stratford, where he must face a troubled past and a neglected family. Haunted by the death of his only son, Hamnet, he struggles to mend the broken relationship with his wife and daughters. In so doing, he is ruthlessly forced to examine his own failings as a husband and father. (Historical drama) - 2018

skydrama.uk.title: The Room Next Door (2024)

skydrama.uk.title: Bohemian Rhapsody (2018)

He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water. (Action / Science fiction) - 1995

skygreats.uk.title: Batman & Robin (1997)

(Action / Adventure / Fantasy) - 1997

skygreats.uk.title: Jaws (1975)

skygreats.uk.title: Jaws 2 (1978)
skygreats.uk.description: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare. (Adventure / Horror / Thriller) - 1978

skygreats.uk.title: Jaws III (1983)
skygreats.uk.description: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene. (Horror / Thriller) - 1983

skygreats.uk.title: Fatal Attraction (1987)
skygreats.uk.description: A glamorous career woman loses control when her married lover, a Manhattan attorney, ends their brief affair. Unable to accept his rejection, she pursues him at the office, and then at his home, eventually drawing his wife and daughter into the confrontation. (Drama / Romance / Thriller) - 1987

skygreats.uk.description: While visiting London with his family, Jack Ryan foils an IRA attempt to assassinate a government minister, killing one of the attackers in the process.
